name: Happiness 2 : The Game
source:
"Would you find the path that leads to "Her" or forever be lost to time?"

The game picks up a few weeks after the events of the first game.

It is now the last week of the school year, once again you play as the weirdly nameless 17-years-old high school student. While he struggles to cope with the events of the first game, he suddenly finds himself facing up a danger far greater than anything he would imagine.

Play though multiple timelines, discover "never revealed before" backstories and secrets of the "Happiness" universe.

Your choices will not only shape your world but all of the worlds that exist in the vast sea that is "Time".

Much like the first game, this game deals with themes such as family, pseudo-science and time travel in addition to romance, mystery and the multiverse theory.

[Edited from [url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/happiness-2-the-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你能否找到通往“她”的道路，还是永远迷失在时间之中？”

故事从第一部事件发生几周后继续展开。

如今已是学年最后一周，你再次扮演那位名字奇怪地未曾揭晓的17岁高中生。他正努力应对第一部中的种种事件，却突然发现自己面临着远超想象的危险。

穿梭于多条时间线，揭开《Happiness》世界中“此前从未公开”的背景故事与秘密。

你的选择不仅会塑造自己的世界，也会影响“时间”这片浩瀚之海中存在的所有世界。

与第一部相似，本作涉及家庭、伪科学、时间旅行等主题，也包含爱情、悬疑和多元宇宙理论。

[改写自[url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/happiness-2-the-game]Itch.io[/url]]
